scope: One fresh Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster. Server-side dry-run compares the same schema-valid, inert pause Pod with only runAsNonRoot changed, before and after Restricted PSA labels are applied to one typed synthetic AI namespace. A ValidatingAdmissionPolicy requires immutable AI classification and Restricted enforce/audit/warn labels pinned to v1.36. A separate ordinary namespace checks namespace matching. Native metadata audit events record the proposed Baseline AI namespace and its Pod-level Restricted violation. All Pod requests are server-side dry-run. Read-only label, policy and binding evidence steps are exercised against this fixture. Adopters verify their namespace inventory, exceptions and audit delivery in their environment.
